title: Wedding toast (Bridge)
script:
Tunde and Amaka met at karaoke, both reaching for the same Whitney Houston song.
They've been doing duets ever since, mostly arguing over who gets the Beyoncé part.
Their first holiday was a road trip with nothing but Fela Kuti and a broken GPS.
May your marriage outlast every season of Big Brother.
note: Original material; the couple is fictional. Bridge: friends 18-34 and parents 55+.
